Container.Name: Unraid-Next-Dashboard
Container.Overview: A radical reimagining of the Unraid WebGUI — Minimalist, Atmospheric, and Human-Centric. Features: - Serene mountain and drifting fog backdrop (Antoine Barrès & CodePen animation). - Centered ergonomic workstation (zero vertical scrolling at 1080p). - Orange Glass Storage Hero Card with live free space breakdown and NVMe tier. - 3× more compact circular telemetry widgets (CPU, RAM, Net, GPU). - Real-time Docker container launcher and monitoring dock. - Modern folder-based storage browser.
Container.Description: Modern, atmospheric React 19 dashboard prototype for Unraid with live Docker & host telemetry.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Unraid Next Dashboard
